---
title: "check-single-ask-parts.yml"
---

Diff-scoped check that warns when a pull request adds or revises
an exercise part that asks for more than one thing.
The lab's rule (Ezra, 2026-10-27) is that each exercise part asks for one thing,
and a part that asks for several is split into several parts,
with the solution split the same way.

A part is a list item or a paragraph in the body of an `exr-` div,
outside any nested `.sol` or `.solution` div.
An ask is a clause that opens with an imperative verb the exercises use,
such as Compute, Find, Show, Compare, Plot or Explain.
The check reports a part with two or more asks:
two such sentences,
or one sentence whose clauses after ", and", ", then", "; then", "and then" or "and also"
open with such a verb.

The check does not count:

- anything inside a code fence, an HTML comment, display math or inline math;
- a part that carries `<!-- single-ask-ok: reason -->` on its first line or the line before it,
  or an exercise that carries it anywhere.

A part the pull request does not touch is never reported.
With no base to diff against, the check skips
instead of scanning the whole tree.
It is a heuristic, so it warns by default;
`fail: true` makes it block.

## Inputs

| Input | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `globs` | `*.qmd` | Git pathspecs of tracked files to check (recursive) |
| `paths-ignore` | none | Comma or newline separated globs to skip |
| `fail` | `false` | Fail on a finding; `false` warns |
| `whole-tree` | `false` | Scan every part, to measure a corpus |
| `python-version` | `3.x` | Python version |

## Usage

Copy `examples/check-single-ask-parts.yml` to
`.github/workflows/check-single-ask-parts.yml`.
